title: Jos, Plateau — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

content:
Overview

Jos is a city in Plateau with a population of 1,020,000. A city on the Jos Plateau known for its cool climate, tin mining history, and as a tourist destination in central Nigeria. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 18.0.
